function.name: search_docs
function.description: Search the fixed Alias v2.2 no-rerank canonical corpus and return up to eight fused document candidates with their best blocks. Use a concise evidence-oriented query and retry only with a meaningfully different query. The first result for each doc_id in an episode includes the complete document_identity navigation metadata. Later results for the same doc_id omit the full identity and include only document_identity_ref with repeated_query=true; use the complete identity already visible in the episode history. document_identity and document_identity_ref are navigation metadata, not citable evidence.

query.title: Query
query.description: Search terms derived only from the visible question and options.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Number of fused document candidates to return.

function.name: search_in_document
function.description: Search every canonical block inside a document previously returned by search_docs using one query or 2-4 ordered queries. Each query independently uses the persistent document BM25 cache and returns its own results without fusion, reranking, or cross-query scoring. Results include section metadata, matched rows, scope, and versioned table_context; no runtime index build is allowed.

doc_id.title: Doc Id
doc_id.description: Opaque doc_id copied exactly from a successful search_docs result.

query.title: Query
query.description: One keyword query; provide exactly one of query or queries.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Two to four ordered keyword queries; provide exactly one of query or queries. NFKC-trimmed queries must be distinct.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Number of block hits returned independently for each query.

function.name: read_section
function.description: Read exact canonical text from a located doc_id/block_id at a zero-based line offset. The result may include table_context metadata; borrowed headers must be read from header_source.block_id before they can be cited.

doc_id.title: Doc Id
doc_id.description: Opaque doc_id copied exactly from a successful search result.

block_id.title: Block Id
block_id.description: Opaque block_id copied exactly from a successful search result or legal continuation.

row_offset.title: Row Offset
row_offset.description: Zero-based source line offset within the block.

max_chars.title: Max Chars
max_chars.description: Maximum canonical text characters to return.

function.name: find_in_block
function.description: Find literal NFKC and case-compatible keywords inside a previously located block and return bounded exact source contexts. Use it to navigate long blocks; it does not perform semantic search or regex execution.

doc_id.title: Doc Id
doc_id.description: Opaque doc_id copied exactly from a successful search result.

block_id.title: Block Id
block_id.description: Opaque block_id copied exactly from a successful search result.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Literal keywords to locate in the block.

match_mode.title: Match Mode
match_mode.description: Whether a returned merged context must contain any or all keywords.

before_chars.title: Before Chars
before_chars.description: Context characters before a literal match.

after_chars.title: After Chars
after_chars.description: Context characters after a literal match.

max_matches.title: Max Matches
max_matches.description: Maximum merged source contexts to return.

function.name: cite
function.description: Record an exact or uniquely whitespace-mappable quote from canonical text already returned by read_section or find_in_block for the same doc_id/block_id. Table metadata or a borrowed header is not citeable until its source block has been read.

block_id.title: Block Id
block_id.description: Opaque source block_id whose text was shown to the model.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Exact continuous quote, or a uniquely whitespace-mappable quote, from visible canonical text.

occurrence.title: Occurrence
occurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence only when identical text appears multiple times in the same block.

function.name: compute
function.description: Deterministic Decimal arithmetic. Supports + - * / ** (fractional powers need a positive base), parentheses, × ÷, numeric percent suffixes, and max, min, abs, round(x, n), sum, avg, sqrt, ln, log10, exp. Examples: CAGR (v1/v0)**(1/n)-1; max(a-b, c); avg(x1, x2, x3). Returns result rounded to precision and the unrounded result_exact; use result_exact or one combined expression for intermediate values.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Optional variable-to-numeric-string mapping; values may use a trailing % or ％.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: Decimal places for the ROUND_HALF_UP result; result_exact is not rounded.

function.name: date_calc
function.description: Calculate a date or deadline deterministically. Working-day mode excludes weekends only; it does not infer statutory holidays.

base_date.description: Base date in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY年M月D日 form.
base_date.title: Base Date

count_from.title: Count From
count_from.description: For unit=day: next_day excludes base_date and treats the following eligible day as day 1; same_day includes base_date as day 1.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Natural days or weekend-only working days.

function.name: write_note
function.description: Replace the current episode working note and compact the context. After a successful note, earlier tool calls and results are removed; the next request contains only the system prompt, the question, and this note, and later calls continue after it. Write everything still needed: confirmed numbers with unit and period, doc_id/block_id, per-option conclusions, and open questions. Re-read a block before citing it.

note.title: Note
note.description: Free-text replacement for the current episode note; 1-800 characters.

function.name: finalize
function.description: Submit the final answer and terminate after at least one successful document search. Recheck multi-select letters against the option-by-option conclusions before calling.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Only the requested final answer values, without explanation, labels, formula, or unit.

function.name: escalate
function.description: Terminate diagnostically only when evidence is genuinely unavailable, conflicting, out of scope, or resources are exhausted after at least one successful search. Escalated traces are never accepted or SFT eligible.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Concise evidence-based explanation without hidden Gold data.
